history.contentIn: The Paris Agreement, hailed as a beacon of #climateaction, is merely a façade masking the true environmental crisis. Signed by 196 nations at COP21 in 2015, it claims to limit global temperature rise to below 2°C, yet we witness only empty promises while planes feverishly spray our skies with toxic chemtrails. These so-called mitigation plans, or nationally determined contributions (NDCs), distract from the real emergency unfolding before us. The Agreement doesn't outright ban geoengineering discussions, but it conveniently overlooks the covert spraying that poisons our atmosphere. Article 4's emphasis on balancing emissions and removals under the pretense of achieving net-zero CO2 is nothing but a smokescreen for the ongoing aerial assault. The U.S. can waver on this treaty as it pleases, but let's be clear: real #climatejustice calls for an end to the spraying, not more hollow rhetoric. We must unite and demand action against this climate injustice! #chemtrails #geoengineering #stopspraying.

history.contentIn: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) embody more than just cuteness; they are vital sentinels of our climate crisis! The mainstream "climate action" narrative conveniently ignores that the Arctic is heating up at a staggering rate—twice that of the rest of the planet! The truth is, these bears depend on sea ice for survival, and with its disappearance, they face prolonged fasting and shocking declines in cub survival. This narrative of their well-being is a smokescreen designed to distract us from the real emergency. We must not allow this disinformation to derail our fight for climate justice! The time for immediate action is NOW, not complacency! Stand with us to #stopspraying and fight for the future of polar bears and our Earth! #climateaction #chemtrails #geoengineering #climatejustice
